newsitem.title: USA: Glenayre sees down Q3, cites orders, sales. [CORRECTED 16/0 21:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Glenayre sees down Q3, cites orders, sales. [CORRECTED 16/0 21:00 GMT]

text.p: Glenayre Technologies Inc said on Friday it expected its third quarter 1996 net income to be 40 to 45 percent below the same quarter last year, (corrects percentage range from "40 to 50 percent") because of orders, sales mix and expenses.
Both sales and earnings would be well below Wall Street third quarter estimates, the company said in a statement.
While Glenayre said it believed it maintained its market share throughout the quarter, a lack of short-term shippable orders, sales mix and expense levels would hurt earnings.
It said third quarter net sales might be higher than last year's third quarter, but would be below analyst estimates.

Glenayre said it remained optimistic about its future growth based on strong forecast and record backlog from worldwide markets. Narrowband personal communications system beta tests continued to achieve outstanding results, it said.
The company provides telecommunications equipment and related software to wireless personal communications service providers.
